Interface MailboxSpi

All Superinterfaces:
Sweepable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractMailboxSpi, DynamoDbMailboxSpi, HazelcastMailboxSpi, InMemoryMailboxSpi, MongoDbMailboxSpi, NatsMailboxSpi, PostgresMailboxSpi, RedisMailboxSpi
public interface MailboxSpi extends Sweepable
Backend SPI for Mailbox storage operations.

A mailbox supports single-delivery semantics: exactly one value may be delivered before the mailbox expires. Each mailbox has a TTL that governs its lifetime. All methods may be called from multiple threads concurrently and must be thread-safe.

    • exists

      boolean exists(String key)
      Returns whether a live mailbox exists at the given key.

      A mailbox is "live" if it was created and has not expired, regardless of whether a value has been delivered.

      Parameters:
      key - the backend storage key
      Returns:
      true if a live mailbox exists at this key

      Removes the mailbox. This operation is idempotent — deleting a non-existent mailbox is a no-op.
